description: Look up the statutory headline rate for a country (and US state / Canadian province). Answers 'what should I charge in Ontario', 'what is the VAT in Germany'. This is a reference lookup — it changes NOTHING and creates nothing; use create_tax_rate to actually charge it. Report the `confidence` and any `note` back to the merchant verbatim: local / city taxes are not included and the merchant, not you, decides the real rate.

state.description: US state or Canadian province code, e.g. "NY", "ON". Needed for US and CA
